paths_reviewed.review_notes: The runner requires REDIS_RATE_LIMITER_TEST_URL, builds the fixed @cvg-his-v2/shared-rate-limiter workspace, then runs its compiled dist/rate-limiter.test.js with node --test TAP. It requires TAP summaries to say zero skipped/todo, but does not validate URL scheme/host, set a subprocess timeout, or require a nonzero/expected test count. CI sets redis://localhost:6380 and its job provisions a pinned Redis service. The related compiled test uses unique process/time key prefixes and resetAll scoped to those prefixes; no FLUSHDB behavior was observed.

build.scope: TypeScript package build; generated dist is ignored by Git; no Redis/DB/network call.

source_test_attempt.summary: 23 passed, one failed, two skipped. The failed test starts Node with an import.meta.url pointing to src/index.js, which does not exist from the TypeScript source location. The mandatory runner builds and tests dist instead; this was an invalid source-mode invocation, not the CI runner path.

built_test.scope: The two live Redis tests were skipped because the Redis URL was explicitly unset. A loopback-only refusal probe at 127.0.0.1:1 and fake-client tests ran. No external Redis was contacted.

boundary_review.ci_reference: Round 14 reviewed the edited CI job: a pinned Redis service is mapped to localhost:6380 and REDIS_RATE_LIMITER_TEST_URL is set for pnpm test and pnpm test:redis.
boundary_review.test_data: The live tests generate per-process/time key prefixes and reset only matching keys; no database FLUSHDB or global keyspace clearing is in the reviewed test code.
boundary_review.local_effect: The package TypeScript build generated ignored dist output. It remains in the workspace as a build artifact; it did not alter tracked files.

findings_and_limits.observation: The runner accepts any nonempty REDIS_RATE_LIMITER_TEST_URL and passes the whole process environment to build/test. The live test uses unique prefixed keys and scoped reset, but a manually configured shared or production Redis endpoint would still receive writes/deletes in that prefix.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Require an explicitly disposable/loopback target or other approved isolation token before running; do not execute this shard with an ambient unknown URL.

findings_and_limits.observation: Both build and node --test use spawnSync without a timeout in the runner. An unresponsive build or Redis endpoint can block until the CI job limit; there is no runner-level timeout policy.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Add bounded child timeouts and verify child termination/cleanup.

findings_and_limits.observation: The runner checks only that TAP reports zero skipped and zero todo after exit status 0; it does not assert a positive or frozen total test count, so a zero-test or stale dist bundle could satisfy the summary predicate.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Assert an expected minimum/count or required integration test names and clean stale build output before running the shard.

findings_and_limits.observation: The actual mandatory runner was not invoked because no disposable Redis target was selected. The built suite ran with the Redis URL unset, so two integration tests skipped.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Run the shard only in the CI-local pinned Redis service or another explicitly approved disposable target.

candidate_actions.hold_reason: Runner hash is stable and non-Redis suite/build checks are bounded, but live Redis target validation, child timeouts and positive test-count guarantees remain open.

limitations: No live Redis service or external cache was contacted.
The TS source-mode test attempt is recorded separately from the built dist run used by the canonical runner.
Primary-operator review only; no independent inclusion approval.
